# healthchecks_project (Data Source)

Looks up an existing project by UUID using the provider's username and password. The result includes the project name and key-enabled flags.
## Example Usage

```terraform
data "healthchecks_project" "existing" {
  id = var.project_id
}

variable "project_id" {
  type = string
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Project UUID.

### Read-Only

- `api_key_enabled` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `ping_key_enabled` (Boolean)
- `read_only_api_key_enabled` (Boolean)
